- **ImportAttributesFromProject** (since 2.0.0): Imports Line, Fill, ZoneCategory, PenTable, OperationProfile, Composite, Profile and LayerCombination attributes from another project or template file into the open project, with their complete definition (symbol and percent fills included), like Append or Overwrite by name in Archicad's Attribute Manager.
- **GetUsedAttributes** (since 1.8.0): Gets how many attributes of each type are in use (layers, lines, fills, composites, surfaces, ...), as Archicad reports them for the usedAttributes JSON query: the counts in usedAttributes, the report as text in raw.
- **ConsolidateLines** (since 1.8.0): Runs the Line Consolidation menu command of Archicad on the current window, as the menu does, and reports whether it ran together with what Archicad answered.
- **ConsolidateFills** (since 1.8.0): Runs the Fill Consolidation menu command of Archicad on the current window, as the menu does, and reports whether it ran together with what Archicad answered.
- **CreateAttributeFolders** (since 1.7.3): Creates attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path (the folder names from the root folder down).
- **DeleteAttributeFolders** (since 1.7.3): Deletes attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path, together with all the subfolders and deletable attributes they contain (a folder holding an attribute that cannot be deleted is kept).
- **RenameAttributeFolders** (since 1.7.3): Renames attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path, to the given new names.
- **MoveAttributesAndFolders** (since 1.7.3): Moves attributes and attribute folders (with their contents) into the target folder, which must be of the same attribute type; an empty target path is the root folder.
- **ReindexLayers** (since 2.0.0): Moves layers to new indices.
- **ReindexAttributes** (since 2.0.0): Moves fills, line types, surfaces, building materials and zone categories to new indices, the way ReindexLayers moves layers.
- **DeleteAndReplaceAttributes** (since 2.0.0): Deletes fills, line types, surfaces, building materials, profiles, zone categories or layers and replaces each by another attribute of the same type wherever it was used, like Delete and Replace in the Attribute Manager.
- **GetUnusedAttributes** (since 2.0.0): Lists the unused layers, fills, surfaces, building materials, composites, profiles, line types, pen tables and zone categories (index, id and name), for the given types or all of them.
- **GetMissingAttributes** (since 2.0.0): Lists the references of placed elements to layers, fills, surfaces, building materials, composites, profiles, line types, pen tables and zone categories that do not exist in the project, for the given types or all of them, and of the tool defaults, Favorites, graphic override rules, Model View Options combinations and attributes: the structured counterpart of the missing attributes report of Archicad's GDL palette.
- **CreateLayers** (since 1.0.3): Creates or overwrites Layer attributes based on the given parameters.
- **CreateLayerCombinations** (since 1.2.4): Creates or overwrites Layer Combination attributes based on the given parameters.
- **CreateLines** (since 1.5.4): Creates or overwrites Line attributes based on the given parameters.
- **CreateFills** (since 1.5.4): Creates or overwrites Fill attributes based on the given parameters.
- **CreateZoneCategories** (since 1.5.4): Creates or overwrites Zone Category attributes based on the given parameters.
- **CreateMEPSystems** (since 1.5.4): Creates or overwrites MEP System attributes (domain, pens, fill, center line type, surface and insulation surface) based on the given parameters.
- **CreatePenTables** (since 1.5.4): Creates or overwrites Pen Table attributes based on the given parameters.
- **ModifyPens** (since 1.7.2): Changes the color, width and description of single pens of the Pen Table in effect for the model views (the default) or the layouts, keeping every other pen as it is.
- **CreateProfiles** (since 1.5.4): Creates or overwrites Profile attributes as a copy of an existing Profile's geometry, based on the given parameters.
- **CreateBuildingMaterials** (since 1.0.1): Creates or overwrites Building Material attributes based on the given parameters.
- **CreateComposites** (since 1.0.2): Creates or overwrites Composite attributes based on the given parameters.
- **CreateSurfaces** (since 1.2.2): Creates or overwrites Surface attributes based on the given parameters.
- **GetBuildingMaterialPhysicalProperties** (since 0.1.3): Retrieves the physical properties of the given Building Materials.
- **GetLayerCombinations** (since 1.2.4): Returns the details of layer combination attributes.
- **GetCurrentLayerCombination** (since 1.7.3): Returns the layer combination in effect in the current window.
- **ActivateLayerCombination** (since 2.0.0): Activates the given layer combination in the current window, like choosing it in the Quick Layers palette.
- **GetLayerOfElementDefaults** (since 2.0.0): Returns the layer of the tool defaults of the given element types: the layer new elements of that type are placed on.
- **SetLayerOfElementDefaults** (since 2.0.0): Sets the layer of the tool defaults of the given element types, so new elements of that type are placed on it.
- **RenameAttributes** (since 2.0.0): Renames attributes of any type (layers, layer combinations, composites, surfaces, ...).
- **ModifyLayers** (since 2.0.1): Changes the given settings of existing layers: shown or hidden, locked, wireframe, the intersection group and the name.
- **GetLines** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Line attributes.
- **GetFills** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Fill attributes.
- **GetZoneCategories** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Zone Category attributes.
- **GetMEPSystems** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given MEP System attributes (domain, pens, fill, center line type, surface and insulation surface).
- **GetPenTables** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Pen Table attributes.
- **GetCurrentPenTable** (since 1.7.3): Returns the current Pen Table (its index, attribute identifier and name) and its number of pens.
- **GetPens** (since 1.8.0): Returns the given pens, or all of them, in effect in the current window: index, color, width and description.
- **SetPens** (since 2.0.0): Changes the color, width and description of the given pens in effect in the current window, the pens GetPens returns, in one undo step.
- **GetProfiles** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Profile attributes.
- **GetComposites** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Composite attributes.
- **GetSurfaces** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Surface attributes.
- **GetLayers** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Layer attributes.
- **GetBuildingMaterials** (since 1.5.4): Returns the details of the given Building Material attributes.
- **GetFontsByName** (since 1.7.3): Finds loaded fonts by name through Archicad's font search and returns their index (as Text and Label fields reference fonts in fontIndex) and name, or an error for a name no loaded font has.
- **GetGraphicOverrideRules** (since 1.7.2): Gets all graphic override rules of the project, with their rule group, criterion and style.
- **GetGraphicOverrideRulesByName** (since 1.7.3): Gets graphic override rules by name, with their rule group, criterion and style.
- **CreateGraphicOverrideRules** (since 1.7.2): Creates graphic override rules.
- **ModifyGraphicOverrideRules** (since 1.7.2): Modifies the name, criterion or style of graphic override rules.
- **DeleteGraphicOverrideRules** (since 1.7.2): Deletes graphic override rules.
- **GetGraphicOverrideCombinations** (since 1.7.2): Gets all graphic override combinations of the project with the rules they contain.
- **CreateGraphicOverrideCombinations** (since 1.7.2): Creates graphic override combinations from existing rules.
- **ModifyGraphicOverrideCombinations** (since 1.8.0): Modifies the name and/or the rules of graphic override combinations.
- **DeleteGraphicOverrideCombinations** (since 1.7.2): Deletes graphic override combinations.
- **CreateGraphicOverrideRuleGroups** (since 1.8.0): Creates empty graphic override rule groups.
- **GetGraphicOverrideRuleGroups** (since 1.7.2): Gets all graphic override rule groups of the project with the rules they contain, empty groups included.
- **SetGraphicOverrideRuleOrder** (since 1.8.0): Sets the order of the rules in graphic override rule groups, found by name.
- **RenameGraphicOverrideRuleGroups** (since 1.7.3): Renames graphic override rule groups, found by name.
- **DeleteGraphicOverrideRuleGroups** (since 1.7.2): Deletes graphic override rule groups, found by name.
- **SetGraphicOverrideRuleGroupOrder** (since 1.8.0): Sets the order of the graphic override rule groups, found by name.
- **MoveGraphicOverrideRules** (since 1.7.3): Moves graphic override rules to another rule group, or to another place in their own group.
- **GetUserDataOfAttributes** (since 1.8.0): Reads the key-value pairs stored on attributes by SetUserDataOfAttributes.
- **SetUserDataOfAttributes** (since 1.8.0): Stores string values under keys in the user data of attributes, for scripts to keep their own state on an attribute.
- **DeleteUserDataOfAttributes** (since 1.8.0): Removes the user data of attributes, every key at once.

## IFC Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/ifc.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/ifc.md).

- **IFCFileOperation** (since 1.2.6): Executes an IFC file operation: opens or merges an IFC file, or saves the project as an IFC file.
- **GetIFCExportTranslators** (since 1.6.0): Lists the IFC export translators of the project in the order of Archicad's translator list. preview marks the first one, which the Archicad API documents as the preview translator; no API identifies the preview translator otherwise, and in some projects the IFC Translators dialog shows another one as preview.
- **GetElementsByIFCIds** (since 1.5.1): Retrieves the elements by the given IFC identifiers.
- **GetIFCIdsOfElements** (since 1.5.1): Retrieves the IFC identifiers of the given elements.
- **GetIFCTypeOfElements** (since 1.5.1): Retrieves the IFC types of the given elements.
- **GetIFCPropertiesOfElements** (since 1.5.1): Retrieves the IFC properties of the given elements.
- **GetIFCAttributesOfElements** (since 1.7.3): Retrieves the IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, PredefinedType, LongName, ...) of the given elements, subelements included: the name, the IFC value type and the value of each attribute.
- **SetIFCAttributesOfElements** (since 1.7.3): Sets the values of IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, ...) of elements.
- **SetIFCPropertiesOfElements** (since 1.7.0): Sets local IFC properties on elements by creating or modifying single value (IfcPropertySingleValue) properties in the given property sets.
- **GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the IFC classification references of the given elements, subelements included: identification, name, location, description and sort (from Archicad 29), the name of the IfcRelAssociatesClassification (from Archicad 28), the referenced classification (name, source, edition, edition date, description and location) and whether the reference comes from the preview translator or is stored locally.
- **SetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements** (since 1.8.0): Stores IFC classification references (identification, name, location and the referenced classification with its name, edition, edition date, description and location) on elements.
- **RemoveIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements** (since 1.8.0): Removes IFC classification references stored on elements, given by the name of their classification and optionally their identification; without identification every stored reference of that classification is removed.
- **RemoveIFCPropertiesOfElements** (since 1.7.3): Removes local IFC properties, given by property set and property name, from elements.
- **GetIFCSpatialStructure** (since 2.0.0): Returns the IfcProject, IfcSite and IfcBuilding objects of the project's IFC model (hash value, IFC type and GlobalId), and for the given elements the index of the story they are assigned to in the IFC model.
- **GetIFCAssignments** (since 2.0.0): Returns the IFC assignments of the project: the root IFC groups, and for each object the objects assigned to it (children) and the objects it is assigned to (parents).

## Library Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/library.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/library.md).

- **GetLibraries** (since 1.0.1): Gets the list of loaded libraries.
- **ReloadLibraries** (since 1.0.0): Executes the reload libraries command.
- **AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary** (since 1.2.2): Adds the given files into the embedded library.
- **DeleteEmbeddedLibraryItems** (since 1.6.0): Deletes the given items from the embedded library.
- **CreateLibraryParts** (since 1.8.0): Creates GDL library parts in the embedded library from their scripts (master, 2D, 3D, parameter, interface, properties) and parameter definitions, under the given parent subtype.
- **CreateFolderInEmbeddedLibrary** (since 1.7.3): Creates a folder, with any missing parent folders, inside the embedded library.
- **CopyFilesIntoEmbeddedLibrary** (since 1.7.3): Copies the given files, keeping their names, into a folder of the embedded library with one library operation.
- **SetLibraries** (since 1.5.9): Makes the given folders the project's local libraries; built-in, embedded, server and web libraries are kept.
- **AddLibraries** (since 1.5.9): Adds the given folders to the project's local libraries, skipping any already loaded.
- **GetAvailableLibraryParts** (since 1.5.0): Lists library parts currently available to the project.
- **GetLibraryPartSections** (since 2.0.0): Lists the sections of library parts given by index: their four-character type code, sub-identifier, size and whether they are text (scripts, comments) or binary (previews).
- **GetLibraryPartSection** (since 2.0.0): Reads the text of a text section (a script or the comment) of a library part given by index, without opening it in the GDL editor.
- **GetLibrariesOfLibParts** (since 2.0.0): Gets the library of each given library part (by file name or guid): display name, location, embedded/built-in/package/local/missing flags and the Library Manager tree path.
- **GetLibraryPartTypeDetails** (since 2.0.0): Returns the type details of the given library parts (ACAPI_LibraryPart_GetDetails): full unique ID and its direct parent's, type, the detail flags of objects, lamps, labels and zones, the frame and orientation settings of doors and windows, and the element type and variation of the tool that places the library part.
- **IsLibraryPartSubtypeOf** (since 2.0.0): Checks for each of the given library parts whether the given ancestor is anywhere up its subtype hierarchy (e.g. whether a part is a kind of furniture), independent of its name.
- **GetGDLParametersOfLibraryParts** (since 2.0.0): Gets the default GDL parameters (name, display name, type, array dimensions, value, flags) of the given library parts by name, read from the library part without placing it or changing any defaults.
- **GetMissingLibPartNames** (since 2.0.0): Gets the library part name of the given placed Object, Lamp, Window or Door elements, even if the library containing the part is not loaded.
- **GetUnusedLibraryParts** (since 2.0.0): Lists the loaded library parts that no element of the project is placed from.
- **FindLibraryParts** (since 2.0.0): Finds loaded library parts with the Library Manager: all of them, GDL objects, images or text files, optionally only those whose name contains a text.
- **GetLibraryPartDetails** (since 2.0.0): Gets the details of loaded library parts, by name or index: path, library tree path, containing library, and for GDL objects the GUID, subtype, license, UI default flag, which scripts and pictures they have, and optionally the interface and migration scripts.
- **ModifyLibraryList** (since 2.0.0): Adds libraries by path and removes loaded libraries by name or path, in one change of the library list.
- **GetLibraryPartMetadata** (since 2.0.0): Returns the description, keywords, author and placeable, password protected and hierarchical pages flags of loaded library parts, given by file name.
- **GetLibraryPartOriginalLocations** (since 1.8.0): Gets the original location of the given library parts, the file they came from, e.g. before they were embedded into the project.
- **IsUsableGDLString** (since 1.8.0): Checks whether each of the given strings is usable in GDL, e.g. before writing it into a GDL parameter or script.
- **GetGDLDate** (since 2.0.0): Gets the date GDL scripts see: year, month, day, hour, minute and second.
- **SetGDLDate** (since 2.0.0): Sets the date GDL scripts see: year, month, day, hour, minute and second, as GetGDLDate returns them.
- **CheckLibraries** (since 1.8.0): Checks the loaded libraries with the Archicad API's library check.
- **ResetLibraries** (since 1.8.0): Resets the loaded libraries with the Archicad API's library reset.
- **SetLibraryPartScripts** (since 1.7.3): Sets and deletes the master, parameter, 2D, 3D, properties, interface and forward and backward migration scripts of loaded library parts.
- **SetLibraryPartMetadata** (since 1.8.0): Sets the author, keywords, license, license version, password and the placeable, UI default, subtype and hierarchical pages flags of loaded library parts.
- **GetLibraryPartPictures** (since 1.8.0): Gets the preview picture and the GDL pictures of a loaded library part as base64 encoded PNGs, and from Archicad 29 also their dark user interface variants.
- **SetLibraryPartPictures** (since 1.8.0): Deletes the preview picture, the GDL pictures (and from Archicad 29 their dark variants) or the 2D symbol of a loaded library part, or copies the 2D symbol from another library part.
- **GetLibraryPartCustomSection** (since 1.8.0): Gets a custom section of a loaded library part by its section identifier and index: whether it exists, its data version and its content as base64.
- **SetLibraryPartCustomSection** (since 1.8.0): Creates, replaces or deletes a custom section of a loaded library part.
- **CreateLibraryPart** (since 1.8.0): Creates a new library part file (.gsm) of the given loaded subtype, inheriting its parameters, and reports whether it is loaded with its index and names.
- **GetLibraryPartParameterValues** (since 2.0.0): Returns the parameters of loaded library parts, given by their file name as GetAvailableLibraryParts returns it, with their default values and descriptions, in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements: the read counterpart of SetLibraryPartParameters.
- **UpdateLibraryPartSections** (since 2.0.0): Replaces the text of existing sections (scripts, comment, keywords, copyright) of a loaded library part, found by its name.
- **GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives** (since 2.0.0): Gets the lines, arcs and polygons (with their holes, and whether they are fills) of the 2D symbol of a loaded library part, drawn with its default parameters or with the parameters of a placed instance.
- **SetLibraryPartPictureImages** (since 2.0.0): Sets the preview picture and the GDL pictures of a loaded library part from base64 encoded PNGs, and from Archicad 29 also their dark user interface variants.
- **SetLibraryPartParameters** (since 2.0.0): Sets the parameter values, and optionally the parameter descriptions, of loaded library parts, in the format of SetGDLParametersOfElements.
- **GetLibraryPartScripts** (since 2.0.0): Gets the master, parameter, 2D, 3D and properties scripts of loaded library parts, given by name or by an element placed from them, with the unique ID of each part.
- **GetLibraryPartFileInfo** (since 2.0.0): Reads library part files (.gsm) without loading them into the libraries of the project: the unique ID of the part, the unique ID of its subtype, its master, parameter, 2D, 3D and properties scripts, and, with includeParameters, its parameters with their default values and descriptions (in the format of GetLibraryPartParameterValues).
- **CopyLibraryParts** (since 2.0.0): Copies loaded library parts, given by name or by an element placed from them, under a new file name into a folder, by default the embedded library.
- **GetLibraryPartIdentities** (since 2.0.0): Gets the unique ID (main and revision GUID), the reference GUID and the Teamwork lock status of library parts given by index or file path, and whether they are in a server library.
- **CompareLibraryPartUnIds** (since 2.0.0): Compares two library part unique IDs with Archicad's own comparison and tells whether their main and revision GUIDs are the same.
- **GetLastValidEmbeddedLibraryPartName** (since 2.0.0): Gets the name and file path of the last valid library part of the embedded library.
- **SearchLibraryParts** (since 2.0.0): Finds the loaded library parts derived from an ancestor library part (by its unique ID) whose name matches a pattern with * wildcards.
- **OpenLibraryPartInEditor** (since 1.8.0): Opens a loaded library part, given by its fileName or documentName as returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts, in Archicad's library part editor.
- **CreateLibraryPartFromElements** (since 2.0.0): Creates a library part in the embedded library (or in a given local library folder, which is added to the loaded libraries when needed) whose 2D symbol is a copy of the given 2D drawing elements (lines, polylines, arcs, circles, splines, fills, texts and hotspots), under the given parent subtype, with optional master, 2D, 3D and parameter scripts, comment and keywords.
- **InterpretGDLScript3D** (since 2.0.0): Runs a GDL 3D script, given as text or as the master and 3D scripts of a loaded library part with its default parameters, with the settings of the GDL editor, and returns whether it ran without a GDL error, how many 3D model elements it generated and their bounding box.
- **GetGDLUserGlobals** (since 2.0.0): Returns the current GDL global variables the GDL interpreter gets, with their names, types and values.

## Teamwork Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/teamwork.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/teamwork.md).

- **TeamworkSend** (since 0.1.0): Performs a send operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.
- **TeamworkReceive** (since 0.1.0): Performs a receive operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.
- **GetTeamworkProjectInfo** (since 1.8.0): Tells whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and whether it is online, and returns its BIMcloud server, project name and the current user (id and name).
- **ReserveElements** (since 1.1.4): Reserves elements in Teamwork mode.
- **ReleaseElements** (since 1.1.4): Releases elements in Teamwork mode.
- **GetReservationStatusOfElements** (since 1.7.3): Returns the Teamwork reservation status of elements without reserving them: whether each element is free, reserved by the current user or reserved by another user, with the reserving user.
- **GrantElements** (since 1.7.3): Hands over the reservation of elements to another Teamwork user, given by user id, without a dialog.
- **ReserveLockableObjectSet** (since 1.7.1): Reserves a non-element lockable object set (attributes, favorites, project info, project preferences, etc.) in Teamwork mode.
- **ReleaseLockableObjectSet** (since 1.7.1): Releases a non-element lockable object set reserved with ReserveLockableObjectSet in Teamwork mode.
- **GetLockableObjectSetStatus** (since 1.7.1): Returns the Teamwork reservation status of a non-element lockable object set and the users who hold it.
- **ReserveHotlinkCacheManagement** (since 1.7.1): Reserves the Hotlink and XRef management in Teamwork mode, which is needed before changing hotlink nodes.
- **ReleaseHotlinkCacheManagement** (since 1.7.1): Releases the Hotlink and XRef management in Teamwork mode.
- **GetTeamworkStatus** (since 1.7.3): Returns whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and is online, the members of the shared project and who has reserved the Hotlink and XRef management.
- **GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases** (since 1.8.0): Returns the Teamwork owner (user id and name) of each given database, e.g. of a layout or a view database.
- **UploadLibrariesToBIMcloud** (since 1.8.0): Uploads local library folders or container files (.lcf) to a folder of a BIMcloud or Teamwork server, as BIMcloud libraries.
- **RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloud** (since 1.8.0): Removes libraries, given by name, from a folder of a BIMcloud or Teamwork server.
- **GetTeamworkRightsOfObjects** (since 2.0.0): Returns for each given object, for example an element, whether the current Teamwork user has the right to create objects of its kind and to delete or modify it.
- **GetTeamworkAccessRights** (since 2.0.0): Returns whether the role of the current user has the given Teamwork access rights (API_TWAccessRights names without the API prefix, e.g. LayersCreate), all of them when no names are given.

## Navigator Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/navigator.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/navigator.md).

- **PublishPublisherSet** (since 0.1.0): Performs a publish operation on the currently opened project.
- **GetPublisherSets** (since 2.0.0): Returns the publisher sets of the project with their saved output: the local or LAN path, the Teamwork file server path, or the Internet host and directory name.
- **UpdateDrawings** (since 1.1.4): Performs a drawing update on the given elements.
- **GetDrawingContentBoxes** (since 1.7.3): Returns the full content box of the given Drawing elements, independent of their frames, as ACAPI_Drawing_GetFullDrawingContentBox reports it.
- **GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId** (since 1.1.4): Gets the ID of the database associated with the supplied navigator item id
- **GetDatabases** (since 1.7.3): Lists every database of the given types (sections, elevations, interior elevations, details, worksheets, 3D documents, layouts, master layouts) with its database ID, name and reference ID, without walking the navigator trees.
- **CreateDetails** (since 1.4.0): Creates independent Detail databases.
- **CreateWorksheets** (since 1.4.0): Creates independent Worksheet databases.
- **Create3DDocuments** (since 2.0.1): Creates 3D Documents with the given names and reference IDs, in the Project Map's 3D Documents folder.
- **CreateDetailMarkers** (since 2.0.0): Places Detail markers with their clip polygon in the current floor plan, section or elevation, each with a new Detail viewpoint, like the Detail tool.
- **CreateWorksheetMarkers** (since 2.0.0): Places Worksheet markers with their clip polygon in the current floor plan, section or elevation, each with a new Worksheet viewpoint, like the Worksheet tool.
- **ModifyDetailMarkers** (since 2.0.0): Changes the name, the reference ID, the clip polygon, the boundary's pen and line type, the marker symbol's angle, always-horizontal setting and pen, and 'Copy construction elements only' of Detail and Worksheet markers.
- **CreateLayout** (since 1.4.0): Creates Layouts and their backing master layouts.
- **CreateLayoutSubset** (since 1.4.0): Creates Layout Book subsets.
- **GetLayoutSubsetSettings** (since 1.7.3): Gets the settings of existing Layout Book subsets: the same fields CreateLayoutSubset accepts (name, ID prefix, numbering style, ...).
- **ChangeLayoutSubsetSettings** (since 2.0.1): Changes the settings of existing Layout Book subsets (name, ID prefix, numbering style, start at, ...), the fields of CreateLayoutSubset; the ones not given keep their value.
- **CreateDrawings** (since 1.4.0): Creates Drawing elements on the specified or active layout from navigator items.
- **ChangeDrawingLink** (since 1.5.7): Relinks a Drawing to a different source navigator item.
- **GetLayoutSettings** (since 1.1.7): Gets settings of layouts, including their master layout and Layout Info Panel custom data fields.
- **SetLayoutSettings** (since 1.1.7): Sets settings of layouts, including their master layout and Layout Info Panel custom data fields.
- **GetLayoutCustomScheme** (since 1.1.7): Gets the Layout Info Panel custom field definitions (name and key) from Book Settings.
- **GetDrawingNumberingGridLines** (since 1.8.0): Gets the lines of the grid of the grid-based drawing numbering of the current layout (start and end point, pen index, line type index), for example to find which grid cell a drawing on the layout sits in.
- **GetModelViewOptions** (since 1.1.4): Gets all model view options
- **FindModelViewOption** (since 1.8.0): Finds a model view option combination by id or by name and returns its index, id, name and flags.
- **GetModelViewOptionDetails** (since 2.0.0): Gets the settings stored in model view option combinations (Document > Model View > Model View Options), all of them or the ones given by id or by name: the model view options in the fields of GetViewOptions, and the options library parts add to the combination (gdlOptions) with their GDL parameter values.
- **GetViewOptions** (since 1.8.0): Gets the model view options and on-screen view options of the current plan window, and the index and name of the model view option combination it applies.
- **SetViewOptions** (since 1.8.0): Switches the current plan window to a model view option combination by index, and/or changes the given model view options and on-screen view options.
- **GetViewSettings** (since 1.1.4): Gets the view settings of navigator items
- **SetViewSettings** (since 1.1.4): Sets the view settings of navigator items
- **GetActiveGraphicalOverrideCombination** (since 1.7.2): Gets the graphic override combination applied to the current window, with its id and name.
- **SetActiveGraphicalOverrideCombination** (since 1.7.2): Applies a graphic override combination, given by id or by name, to the current window.
- **GetRenovationFilters** (since 1.8.0): Gets the renovation filters of the project, and the one the current window uses (Document > Renovation > Renovation Filter).
- **SetActiveRenovationFilter** (since 1.8.0): Sets the renovation filter of the current window (Document > Renovation > Renovation Filter), given by its renovationFilterId from GetRenovationFilters or by its name.
- **GetGhostStorySettings** (since 1.8.0): Gets the Trace & Reference ghost story settings of the floor plan: whether it is on, whether one story, the story above or the one below is shown, which story, its color and the element types shown in it.
- **SetGhostStorySettings** (since 1.8.0): Sets the Trace & Reference ghost story settings of the floor plan through its ghost record, which is created when the floor plan has none.
- **GetStructureDisplay** (since 1.7.3): Gets the Partial Structure Display (EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes or StructureOnly) of the current window, and whether it is the 3D window.
- **SetStructureDisplay** (since 1.7.3): Sets the Partial Structure Display (EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes or StructureOnly) of the current window, e.g. the floor plan, a section or the 3D window.
- **GetView2DTransformations** (since 1.1.7): Get zoom and rotation of 2D views
- **SetViewRotation** (since 1.1.7): Set the rotation angle of 2D views via their floor plan database.
- **CloneProjectMapItemToViewMap** (since 1.1.7): Clones Project Map viewpoints into a specified View Map folder.
- **CreateViewsInViewMap** (since 1.1.7): Creates independent (non-clone) navigator views in a specified View Map folder, by copying database and settings from source items.
- **CreateViewMapFolder** (since 1.1.7): Creates a new folder in the View Map.
- **Set3DCutPlanes** (since 1.3.1): Sets the 3D cut planes (pa*x + pb*y + pc*z = pd, cutting away the side the normal points to), with the pen and surface of their cut faces, and turns 3D Cutaway on.
- **Get3DCutPlanes** (since 1.7.3): Gets whether the 3D cut planes are on, the cut planes (pa, pb, pc, pd) of the 3D window with the pen and surface of their cut faces, and the custom cut pen and surface, in the form accepted by Set3DCutPlanes.
- **Get3DStyleDetails** (since 1.7.3): Gets the settings of 3D styles by name (an empty name or no names means the current 3D style): rendering engine, model type, monochrome and background colors, contours, shadows and hatching.
- **Create3DStyles** (since 1.7.3): Creates 3D styles.
- **Change3DStyles** (since 1.7.3): Changes the given fields of existing 3D styles, identified by name.
- **Get3DProjectionSettings** (since 1.7.2): Gets the 3D projection settings of the 3D window: whether it is perspective or axonometric, the camera and target position, view cone, roll angle, distance and azimuth of a perspective, or the projection type, azimuth and transformation matrix of an axonometry, and the sun position of either (date and time or azimuth and altitude).
- **Set3DProjectionSettings** (since 1.7.2): Sets a perspective or an axonometric projection for the 3D window.
- **GetCameras** (since 2.0.0): Gets the Camera Sets (camera paths) of the project with their name, whether the set is the active one, its current camera, and its cameras in path order.
- **CreateCameraSets** (since 2.0.1): Creates empty Camera Sets (camera paths) with the given names, and makes one the active Camera Set when isActive is true.
- **ModifyCameraSets** (since 2.0.1): Renames Camera Sets (camera paths) and makes one of them the active Camera Set (isActive true); the set active before is then no longer active.
- **CreateCameras** (since 2.0.1): Creates perspective cameras, each added at the end of the path of the given Camera Set, from the camera and target positions (with their heights) and optionally the view cone, roll angle, two-point perspective, sun (by angles or by date and time) and pen; the rest comes from the Camera tool defaults.
- **ModifyCameras** (since 2.0.1): Changes perspective cameras: the camera and target positions (with their heights), view cone, roll angle, two-point perspective, sun (by angles or by date and time) and pen.
- **Get3DStyles** (since 2.0.0): Gets the names of the 3D styles of the project and the name of the current one, which the 3D window uses.
- **SetCurrent3DStyle** (since 2.0.0): Meant to make the given 3D style, one of the names Get3DStyles returns, the current one.
- **StoreViewSettings** (since 2.0.0): Stores the current view settings (action Store) and puts them back later (action Restore), for example before and after a script that changes the view.
- **ShowElementsIn3D** (since 2.0.0): Opens the 3D window on the given elements, as Show Selection in 3D does: they become the selection and only they are shown.
- **GetDocumentFrom3DDefaults** (since 1.8.0): Gets the defaults a newly created 3D Document starts with: name, reference ID, vectorial hatching and sun shadows, transparency, connection to the model, surfaces, boundary contours and the uniform cut, uncut, shadow and hidden edge attributes.
- **SetDocumentFrom3DDefaults** (since 1.8.0): Sets the defaults a newly created 3D Document starts with.
- **Get3DWindowSettings** (since 1.7.3): Gets the 3D window settings: the pixel size of the 3D window and the zoom (scale and displacement) of its projection.
- **Set3DWindowSettings** (since 1.7.3): Changes the pixel size of the 3D window and/or the zoom (scale and displacement) of its projection; the values not given are kept.
- **Get3DDocumentSettings** (since 2.0.0): Gets the settings of a 3D Document, given by its navigator item: the element and story filter, the 3D cut, the projection, the window and zoom, the uniform cut and uncut surface attributes, the source and the boundary contours, with the field names of API_DocumentFrom3DType.
- **Set3DDocumentSettings** (since 2.0.0): Changes the given settings of a 3D Document, given by its navigator item, in the form Get3DDocumentSettings returns; the settings not given are kept.
- **Get3DFilterAndCutSettings** (since 1.8.0): Gets the 'Filter and Cut Elements in 3D' settings of the 3D window: the stories shown, the filter mode and which element types are shown.
- **Set3DFilterAndCutSettings** (since 1.8.0): Changes the 'Filter and Cut Elements in 3D' settings of the 3D window; only the given fields and the listed element types change.
- **GetGridSettings** (since 1.8.0): Gets the grid and snap grid settings of the database of the current window, and which database that is.
- **SetGridSettings** (since 1.8.0): Changes the grid and snap grid settings of the database of the current window; only the given fields change.
- **FitInWindow** (since 1.3.1): Zooms to the given elements or fits everything in the window.
- **ZoomToElements** (since 1.8.0): Zooms the current window, 2D or 3D, to the given elements: selects them, zooms to the selection and restores the previous selection unless keepSelection is false.
- **SetZoom** (since 1.7.3): Zooms the current 2D window to the given box in model coordinates.
- **ResetZoom** (since 1.7.3): Steps back in the zoom history of the current window, like Archicad's Zoom Back.
- **CreateSections** (since 1.5.0): Creates Section elements on the floor plan.
- **ModifySections** (since 2.0.0): Changes the name and the reference ID of Section and Elevation elements, which the Project Map and the markers show, and moves their section line (startCoordinate, endCoordinate) and depth line (depth, only with the horizontal range Limited, which SetSectionsAndElevationsDetails sets).
- **CreateInteriorElevations** (since 1.5.8): Creates Interior Elevation elements on the floor plan.
- **CreateElevations** (since 2.0.0): Creates Elevation elements on the floor plan.
- **GetSectionsAndElevationsDetails** (since 2.0.0): Gets every configurable setting of the given Section and Elevation elements, with their name and reference ID.
- **SetSectionsAndElevationsDetails** (since 2.0.0): Sets settings of the given Section and Elevation elements: pens, line types, horizontal and vertical range, model effects, story handles and markers.
- **SetInteriorElevationsDetails** (since 2.0.1): Sets settings of the given Interior Elevation elements: the stories they are shown on, the common marker's visibility, pen, font and sizes, and for each segment, chosen by its index in GetDetailsOfElements' segments, its name, reference ID and the segment settings of SetSectionsAndElevationsDetails.
- **MoveNavigatorItem** (since 1.1.7): Moves a navigator item to a new parent in the navigator tree, or to a new position within its current parent.
- **RenameNavigatorItem** (since 1.1.7): Renames a navigator item or changes its ID.
- **DeleteNavigatorItems** (since 1.1.7): Deletes navigator items from the navigator tree: views and folders of the View Map, layouts and master layouts of the Layout Book, and independent worksheets and details of the Project Map.
- **GetNavigatorItemTree** (since 1.1.7): Returns the full navigator item tree for the specified map.
- **GetSchedules** (since 2.0.0): Returns the Interactive Schedules of the Project Map: navigator item id, name, ID and the folders they are in.
- **GetNavigatorParentItems** (since 1.7.3): Returns the parent of each given navigator item: the folder, subset or layout book item it is in.
- **SetMasterLayoutContext** (since 1.8.0): Sets which layout's context the master layout of the current window is drawn in: its autotexts then show the values of the given layout.
- **GetAddOnViewpointRoots** (since 1.8.0): Returns the roots of the add-on viewpoints: the Project Map items created through the Archicad API by an add-on, as Archicad lists them to Tapir.
- **GetAddOnViewpointChildren** (since 1.8.0): Returns the direct children of an add-on viewpoint root or group.
- **GetAddOnViewpoints** (since 1.8.0): Returns the details of the given add-on viewpoint items: their parent, type (Root, Group or Leaf), ID, name, view settings flags and attached data (base64 encoded).
- **CreateAddOnViewpoints** (since 1.8.0): Creates add-on viewpoint roots, groups and leaf nodes in the Project Map, with their ID, name, view settings flags (leaf nodes only) and attached data (base64 encoded).
- **ChangeAddOnViewpoints** (since 1.8.0): Changes the ID, name, view settings flags or attached data (base64 encoded) of the given add-on viewpoint items; only the given fields are changed.
- **ReorderNavigatorItems** (since 2.0.0): Reorders the children of a navigator item to match the given order.

## Graphic Override Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/graphic-override.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/graphic-override.md).

- **CreateGraphicalOverrideRule** (since 1.7.2): Creates or overwrites a graphic override rule in a rule group: name, criterion XML, surface color and line pen.
- **GetGraphicalOverrideRules** (since 1.7.2): Returns every graphic override rule with its criterion XML.
- **CreateGraphicalOverrideCombination** (since 1.7.2): Creates a graphic override combination from rule names, or replaces the rules of an existing one.
- **GetGraphicalOverrideStyleOfElements** (since 1.8.0): Returns the graphic override style each element is drawn with in the current window: for every overridable member (line type, pens, fill types, surfaces, ...) whether the active graphic override combination replaces it, and with what.

## Issue Management Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/issue-management.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/issue-management.md).

- **CreateIssue** (since 1.0.2): Creates a new issue.
- **DeleteIssue** (since 1.0.2): Deletes the specified issue.
- **GetIssues** (since 1.0.2): Retrieves information about existing issues.
- **AddCommentToIssue** (since 1.0.6): Adds a new comment to the specified issue.
- **GetCommentsFromIssue** (since 1.0.6): Retrieves comments information from the specified issue.
- **AttachElementsToIssue** (since 1.0.6): Attaches elements to the specified issue.
- **DetachElementsFromIssue** (since 1.0.6): Detaches elements from the specified issue.
- **GetElementsAttachedToIssue** (since 1.0.6): Retrieves attached elements of the specified issue, filtered by attachment type.
- **ExportIssuesToBCF** (since 1.0.6): Exports specified issues to a BCF file.
- **ImportIssuesFromBCF** (since 1.0.6): Imports issues from the specified BCF file.
- **ImportMarkupsFromPDF** (since 1.7.3): Imports the markups of the specified PDF file as issues, like Issue Manager > Import PDF markups, without any dialog and without opening the Issue Manager palette, and reports the issues it created.

## Revision Management Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/revision-management.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/revision-management.md).

- **GetRevisionIssues** (since 1.1.9): Retrieves all issues.
- **ModifyRevisionIssues** (since 1.8.0): Modifies the ID, the short description and the custom scheme data of the given revision issues.
- **GetRevisionChanges** (since 1.1.9): Retrieves all changes.
- **GetRevisionChangeCustomScheme** (since 1.7.3): Retrieves the custom fields of changes (the change custom scheme): the key and the name of each field.
- **GetDocumentRevisions** (since 1.1.9): Retrieves all document revisions.
- **GetCurrentRevisionChangesOfLayouts** (since 1.1.9): Retrieves all changes belong to the last revision of the given layouts.
- **GetRevisionChangesOfElements** (since 1.1.9): Retrieves the changes belong to the given elements.
- **CreateChangeMarkers** (since 2.0.1): Creates Change Markers (revision clouds) in the database of the active window, each with a cloud polygon, its marker components, the position it points to and the position of its marker head.
- **ModifyChangeMarkers** (since 2.0.1): Changes existing Change Markers (revision clouds) with the keys CreateChangeMarkers takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns: the Change the marker is linked to (an existing Change by its ID, a new Change made with createChange, or no Change with linkType Unlinked), the marker components, the angle and always-horizontal setting of the marker head, the position of the marker head (markerPosition), and the point a marker without a cloud polygon points to (position).

## Design Options Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/design-options.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/design-options.md).

- **GetDesignOptions** (since 1.2.9): Retrieves information about existing design options.
- **GetDesignOptionSets** (since 1.2.9): Retrieves information about existing design option sets, and in Teamwork projects the Teamwork identifier of the design options.
- **GetDesignOptionCombinations** (since 1.2.9): Retrieves information about existing design option combinations.
- **GetElementsOfDesignOptions** (since 1.5.1): Retrieves the elements associated with the given design options.
- **GetDesignOptionForElements** (since 1.5.1): Retrieves the design option association for the specified elements.
- **CreateDesignOptionSets** (since 1.5.1): Creates new design option sets with the given names.
- **CreateDesignOptions** (since 1.5.1): Creates new design options with the given parameters.
- **CreateDesignOptionCombinations** (since 1.5.1): Creates new design option combinations with the given parameters.
- **SetActiveDesignOptionsInCombinations** (since 1.5.1): Sets active design options in the given combinations.
- **ActivateDesignOptionsInCombinations** (since 1.8.0): Activates one design option in each of the given combinations, without listing all active design options of the combination.
- **DeactivateDesignOptionsInCombinations** (since 1.7.3): Turns off the given design options in the given combinations, leaving their other options as they are.
- **MoveElementsToDesignOptions** (since 1.5.1): Moves the given elements into the given design options.
- **MoveDesignOptionsToAnotherSet** (since 1.5.1): Moves the given design options to another sets.
- **RenameDesignOptions** (since 1.7.2): Changes the name and/or the string id of the given design options.
- **RenameDesignOptionSets** (since 1.7.2): Changes the name of the given design option sets.
- **RenameDesignOptionCombinations** (since 1.7.2): Changes the name of the given design option combinations.
- **DeleteDesignOptions** (since 1.7.2): Deletes the given design options.
- **DeleteDesignOptionSets** (since 1.7.2): Deletes the given design option sets.
- **DeleteDesignOptionCombinations** (since 1.7.2): Deletes the given design option combinations.
- **GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables** (since 2.0.0): Retrieves the design option table of the given hotlink nodes and placed hotlink instances: the filter mode (main model only, by options or by combination), the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked module and which of them are active.
- **SetHotlinkDesignOptionTables** (since 2.0.0): Sets the filter mode, the active combination and the active option of sets in the design option table of the given placed hotlink instances.
- **SetDefaultDesignOption** (since 1.8.0): Sets the given design option as the default, or the Main Model when no design option is given.
- **GetDefaultDesignOption** (since 2.0.1): Retrieves which design option, or the Main Model, is the default that new elements go to.
- **ReorderDesignOptionSets** (since 1.8.0): Moves the given design option sets before another set or to the end of the list.
- **ReorderDesignOptionsInSet** (since 1.8.0): Moves the given design options before another design option of the same set or to the end of their set.
- **CanMoveElementsToDesignOptions** (since 1.8.0): Checks whether the given elements can be moved to another design option or to the main model, with the reason when they cannot.
- **DuplicateDesignOptionCombinations** (since 1.7.3): Duplicates the given design option combinations and returns the identifiers of the new combinations.
- **GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews** (since 2.0.0): Retrieves which design option combination the given views show: only the main model, a combination, a custom set of design options or a deleted combination.
- **SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews** (since 2.0.0): Sets the design option combination the given views show, or makes them show only the main model.
- **GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails** (since 1.8.0): Reads the design option table of hotlink nodes: the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked source file, and which of them the node shows.

## Keynote Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/keynote.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/keynote.md).

- **GetKeynoteTree** (since 1.5.6): Retrieves the whole keynote folder and item hierarchy.
- **GetKeynoteAutoTexts** (since 1.5.6): Retrieves the autotext tokens of the given keynote items.
- **CreateKeynoteFolders** (since 1.5.6): Creates keynote folders under the given parent folders (or under the root folder).
- **CreateKeynoteItems** (since 1.5.6): Creates keynote items in the given parent folders (or in the root folder).
- **ModifyKeynoteFolders** (since 1.5.6): Modifies the key, title or reference of the given keynote folders.
- **ModifyKeynoteItems** (since 1.5.6): Modifies the key, title, description or reference of the given keynote items.
- **DeleteKeynoteFolders** (since 1.5.6): Deletes the given keynote folders including their content.
- **DeleteKeynoteItems** (since 1.5.6): Deletes the given keynote items.
- **CreateKeynoteLabels** (since 1.5.6): Creates Label elements that reference the given keynote items via autotext.

## Project Data Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/project-data.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/project-data.md).

- **GetProjectDataKeys** (since 1.7.3): Lists the project data stored by Tapir in the project: the names, the identifiers of the add-on objects that store them, whether they are kept on this client only and the Teamwork user who has reserved them.
- **GetProjectData** (since 1.7.3): Gets the content of the project data with the given names.
- **SetProjectData** (since 1.7.3): Creates or overwrites project data: text (for example JSON) saved in the project under a name.
- **DeleteProjectData** (since 1.7.3): Deletes the project data with the given names.
- **ReserveProjectData** (since 1.7.3): Reserves the project data with the given names in Teamwork, so that other users cannot change it.
- **ReleaseProjectData** (since 1.7.3): Releases the project data with the given names in Teamwork.
- **RequestProjectData** (since 1.7.3): Requests the project data with the given names in Teamwork from the users who have reserved it, with an optional message.
- **GrantProjectData** (since 1.7.3): Grants the project data with the given names, reserved by the current user, to another Teamwork user.
- **GetModulData** (since 2.0.0): Gets the module data Tapir stored in the project with StoreModulData: the given names, or all of them, with their data version and, unless includeContent is false, their content.
- **StoreModulData** (since 2.0.0): Creates or overwrites module data: text (for example JSON) saved in the project under a name, with an optional data version.
- **DeleteModulData** (since 2.0.0): Deletes the module data with the given names.

## MEP Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/mep.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/mep.md).

- **GetMEPElements** (since 1.5.6): Retrieves the MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) elements of the project (every element the MEP API lists, and from Archicad 30 the electrical panels and devices), optionally filtered by type and domain.
- **GetMEPRoutingElements** (since 1.5.6): Retrieves the details of the given MEP routing elements: domain, MEP system, offset from the home story, branch preference table, the ports logically connected at the route's beginning and end, the floor plan display settings (cut plane position, floor plan display option, show projection and on-story visibility, from Archicad 29), route polyline, segments with cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), begin and end nodes, anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size, connection style, insulation thickness and rigid segments, and nodes with their incoming and outgoing segments, preferred transition placement, elbows and transitions, and the node positions with the key ModifyMEPRoutingElements writes them with.
- **GetMEPPorts** (since 1.5.6): Retrieves the ports of the given MEP elements including position, shape, size, connection status (Archicad 27: whether the port is connected, from Archicad 28: whether it is physically connected) and connection style (from Archicad 30), the flow direction of piping and ventilation ports (from Archicad 28), the nominal size of piping ports (from Archicad 30), and the outer diameter, wall thickness and flange size (Archicad 30) of piping and ventilation ports.
- **GetMEPDistributionSystems** (since 1.5.6): Retrieves the MEP distribution systems of the project with their domain, MEP system attribute, member elements, physical systems (from Archicad 29) and optionally their tree: the elements from the root element on, each with its previous and next elements and the connecting ports.
- **CreateMEPRoutingElements** (since 1.5.6): Creates MEP routing elements (duct, pipe or cable carrier routes) along the given polylines with optional cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), MEP system and layer (also set on the segments, elbows and transitions), and optional elbow and transition defaults (preference tables and elbow radius factor, from Archicad 29) that apply only to what is placed.
- **CreateMEPElements** (since 1.5.6): Creates MEP elements (Terminal, Accessory, Equipment or Fitting) at the given positions, optionally with another library part, size (from Archicad 30), MEP system, port sizes and shapes and a changed insulation, which apply only to what is placed.
- **ModifyMEPRoutingElements** (since 1.5.6): Modifies the given MEP routing elements: MEP system, branch preference table, floor plan display settings (cut plane position, floor plan display option, show projection and on-story visibility, from Archicad 29), cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size and connection style of all segments, preferred transition placement of all nodes, insulation thickness of the whole route (segments, elbows and transitions), and node positions.
- **RebuildMEPRoutingElements** (since 2.0.1): Rebuilds the given MEP routing elements along new node coordinates or along their current polyline: this adds or removes nodes (bend points), leaves out with removeCollinearNodes the nodes where the route goes straight on (as Purge Unused MEP Nodes does), and with resetCustomSegments resets customized segments and nodes (as Reset Custom Segments does).
- **ModifyMEPPorts** (since 1.8.0): Modifies the given MEP ports (as returned by GetMEPPorts): shape, width, height (not of piping ports), connection style (from Archicad 30), the flow direction of piping and ventilation ports, and the outer diameter and nominal size (from Archicad 30) of piping ports.
- **ConnectMEPElements** (since 1.5.6): Connects MEP routing elements to other MEP elements or routes.
- **CheckMEPPortConnectability** (since 1.8.0): Checks whether MEP ports can be connected to other ports, for the given pairs of ports.
- **GetMEPPreferenceTables** (since 1.5.7): Gets the circular cross section preference tables (referenceId, diameter, wall thickness, description) and the reference set of the Piping or Ventilation domain, optionally with the elbow, branch and transition preference tables, plus the rectangular duct tables of the Ventilation domain or the segment tables of the CableCarrier domain.
- **ModifyMEPPreferenceTables** (since 1.8.0): Modifies the MEP preference tables of a domain, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them: adds tables, changes their names, segmentation lengths (from Archicad 29) and row values and descriptions, deletes or empties rows, adds rows to the rectangular duct and cable carrier tables, deletes tables, deletes reference ids from the reference set, and adds and deletes angles of the angle set (from Archicad 29).
- **GetMEPSystemGroups** (since 1.7.2): Gets the MEP system groups of the project with their physical systems: name, editable flag, root element and MEP system.
- **CreateMEPSystemGroups** (since 1.7.2): Creates MEP system groups.
- **CreateMEPPhysicalSystems** (since 1.7.2): Creates physical systems in MEP system groups, optionally with a root element and an MEP system as their category.
- **ModifyMEPSystemGroups** (since 1.7.3): Renames MEP system groups.
- **ModifyMEPPhysicalSystems** (since 1.7.3): Modifies MEP physical systems: name, root element and the MEP system used as their category.
- **DeleteMEPPhysicalSystems** (since 1.7.3): Removes MEP physical systems from their system groups.
- **GetMEPToolDefaults** (since 2.0.0): Retrieves the current settings of the MEP tools per domain, without changing them: the routing tool (MEP system, branch preference table, floor plan display settings from Archicad 29, and its segment, node, elbow (Archicad 27 and from Archicad 29) and transition defaults), its rigid segment and branch defaults, the flexible segment tool, the library part, insulation and port settings of the terminal, accessory, fitting and equipment tools, and from Archicad 30 the electrical panel tool with its number of circuit defaults.
- **TransferMEPSettings** (since 2.0.0): Picks up the settings of an MEP element and injects them into other MEP elements of the same type and domain, like Archicad's pick up and inject parameters.
- **GetMEPPhysicalSystemsOfElements** (since 2.0.0): Returns the physical systems each of the given MEP elements is part of.
- **CreateMEPFlexibleSegments** (since 2.0.0): Creates MEP flexible segments through the given control points, or along a polyline of alternating line and spline parts (Piping), with the current settings of the Flexible Segment tool of their domain, optionally with the orientation (control points) or direction (polyline) at both ends.
- **CreateMEPTakeOffs** (since 2.0.0): Creates MEP take-offs on the given routing segments, at a distance from the beginning of the segment (not more than its length) and optionally rotated around its axis by a multiple of 90 degrees, with the current settings of the Take-Off tool of their domain (by default the domain of the segment's routing element), optionally with their length and without insulation, which apply only to what is created.
- **ModifyMEPElements** (since 2.0.0): Modifies placed MEP elements: the anchor point, orientation and library part of terminals, accessories, equipment, fittings and flexible segments, their size along the local x and y axes (from Archicad 30), the control points, polyline (Piping, from Archicad 28), and width and height of flexible segments.
- **GetMEPRoutingParameters** (since 1.8.0): Gets the routing parameters of placed MEP elements: of a routing element its routing node parameters (preferred transition placement, elbow from Archicad 29, transition) and routing segment parameters (cross section, preference table, anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size, connection style); of a routing node its elbow (from Archicad 29) and transition parameters; of a routing segment its rigid segment parameters (Archicad 28 only).
- **SetMEPRoutingParameters** (since 1.8.0): Sets the routing parameters of placed MEP elements: the routing segment parameters (cross section and preference table) and, from Archicad 29, the routing node parameters (elbow radius factor and preference table, transition preference table) of routing elements, and the elbow and transition parameters of routing nodes (from Archicad 29).
- **GetElectricalPanels** (since 1.7.2): Gets the electrical panels (distribution boards) of the project or the given ones: name, circuit naming, circuits, parent circuit, placement and the connected and demand loads in total and per phase.
- **GetElectricalCircuits** (since 1.7.2): Gets the given electrical circuits, the circuits of the given panels, or every circuit of the project: name, description, owner panel, connected devices and panels, voltage, phases, wiring type, loads, voltage drop and estimated cable length.
- **GetElectricalDevices** (since 1.7.2): Gets the electrical devices (lights, sockets and other consumers) of the project or the given ones: parent circuit, placement, apparent power, load classification, demand load and directly connected MEP elements.
- **GetElectricalProjectSettings** (since 1.7.2): Gets the electrical project settings: the default voltage, the wiring types with their cross-sectional area and the load classifications with their demand factor.
- **CreateElectricalPanels** (since 1.7.2): Places electrical panels with the default settings of the Electrical Panel tool, optionally with the given library part, size, rotation, mirroring, panel name and circuit naming.
- **CreateElectricalDevices** (since 1.7.2): Places electrical devices with the default settings of the Electrical Device tool, optionally with the given library part, size, rotation, mirroring, apparent power and load classification, and connects them to a circuit.
- **ModifyElectricalPanels** (since 1.7.2): Modifies the name, circuit naming and placement (anchor point, orientation, rotation, mirroring, library part, size) of electrical panels.
- **CreateElectricalCircuits** (since 1.7.2): Adds new circuits to electrical panels, optionally with the given description, voltage, wiring type and used phases.
- **DeleteElectricalCircuits** (since 1.7.2): Removes electrical circuits from their panels.
- **ModifyElectricalCircuits** (since 1.7.2): Modifies the description, voltage, wiring type and used phases of electrical circuits.
- **ModifyElectricalDevices** (since 1.7.2): Modifies the apparent power, load classification and placement (anchor point, orientation, rotation, mirroring, library part, size) of electrical devices.
- **ConnectToElectricalCircuits** (since 1.7.2): Connects electrical devices, or panels as sub-panels, to electrical circuits.
- **ModifyElectricalProjectSettings** (since 1.7.2): Modifies the electrical project settings: sets the default voltage and clears, adds or removes wiring types and load classifications.
- **GetMEPElementDetails** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the type-specific details of the given MEP elements: insulation thickness and routing segment of rigid segments, control points and polyline of flexible segments, radius factor, insulation thickness, preference table and routing node of elbows (from Archicad 29), angle, length and insulation thickness of branches, and offsets, wider and narrower ports, insulation thickness, routing node and (from Archicad 29) preference table of transitions; the width and height of flexible segments, and the anchor point, orientation, library part and (from Archicad 30) size of the elements ModifyMEPElements places, with the keys it writes them with.

## MEP Commands (extended)

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/mep.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/mep.md).

- **GetMEPPreferenceTableRows** (since 1.8.0): Gets rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle): whether the row is valid and its values (diameters, wall thickness, radius, length, angle, branch offset, connection length, description), and whether the table exists.
- **SetMEPPreferenceTableRows** (since 1.8.0): Sets the given values of rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table, found by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle).
- **AddMEPPreferenceTableRows** (since 1.8.0): Adds rows with the given keys and optionally values to a branch, elbow or transition preference table and returns their index, in one undo step.
- **DeleteMEPPreferenceTableRows** (since 1.8.0): Deletes rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle), in one undo step.
- **GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers** (since 1.8.0): Lists the preference tables of the Piping, Ventilation and Cable Carrier preference table containers of Archicad 27: their id, name, whether they exist and their number of rows per shape, and whether the container exists.
- **CreateMEPPreferenceTables** (since 1.8.0): Adds empty preference tables with the given names to the preference table container of a domain of Archicad 27 and returns their id, in one undo step.

## Analytical Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/analytical.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/analytical.md).

- **GetCurrentAnalyticalModel** (since 1.7.3): Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model created for the current view.
- **UpdateAnalyticalModel** (since 1.7.3): Triggers an update of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given.
- **SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule** (since 1.7.3): Sets the generation settings of the current Structural Analytical Model to no rules.
- **GetAnalyticalModelCheckTypeId** (since 1.7.3): Retrieves the type identifier of the Structural Analytical Model check.
- **GetAnalyticalModelVariation** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the variation of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given (the model is required before Archicad 27).
- **GetAnalyticalModel** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model of the given variation, as returned by GetAnalyticalModelVariation.
- **GetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the visibility settings of the Structural Analytical Model.
- **SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings** (since 1.8.0): Changes the given fields of the Structural Analytical Model visibility settings; the others keep their value.
- **GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElements** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the analytical member type (Beam, Column, Roof, Slab, Wall or Unknown) of the given elements from the Complementary Project, the structural analysis project exchanged with Archicad.
- **GetAnalyticalLoadGroups** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the structural analysis load groups of the project, or the ones given by their ids, with all their fields.
- **GetAnalyticalLoadCases** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the structural analysis load cases of the given load group, or of the project when no load group is given, with all their fields.
- **GetAnalyticalLoadCombinations** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the structural analysis load combinations of the project, or the ones given by their ids, with all their fields and load factors.
- **CreateAnalyticalLoadGroups** (since 1.8.0): Creates structural analysis load groups in one undo step and returns their identifiers.
- **CreateAnalyticalLoadCases** (since 1.8.0): Creates structural analysis load cases in the given load groups in one undo step and returns their identifiers.
- **CreateAnalyticalLoadCombinations** (since 1.8.0): Creates structural analysis load combinations, optionally with their load factors, in one undo step and returns their identifiers.
- **DeleteAnalyticalLoadGroups** (since 1.8.0): Deletes the given structural analysis load groups in one undo step.
- **DeleteAnalyticalLoadCases** (since 1.8.0): Deletes the given structural analysis load cases in one undo step.
- **DeleteAnalyticalLoadCombinations** (since 1.8.0): Deletes the given structural analysis load combinations in one undo step.
- **AddLoadCasesToLoadCombination** (since 1.8.0): Adds load cases with their factors to the given structural analysis load combination in one undo step.
- **GetAnalyticalMembers** (since 1.8.0): Lists the elements of the curve and surface members of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given (the model is required before Archicad 27).
- **GetAnalyticalMemberDetails** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the curve, surface or segmented surface member of the given elements in a Structural Analytical Model, with their connections.
- **GetAnalyticalReleases** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the releases of the given analytical members.
- **SetAnalyticalReleases** (since 1.8.0): Replaces the releases of the given analytical members, in one undo step.
- **GetCustomCurveMemberStretch** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the lengths added to the start and end of the given curve members.
- **SetCustomCurveMemberStretch** (since 1.8.0): Sets the lengths added to the start and end of the given curve members, in one undo step.
- **GetLCSOfAnalyticalMembers** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the local coordinate system of the given analytical member parts, optionally in their intersection with another member part.
- **GetAnalyticalMemberPartGeometries** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the node of the given analytical member vertices and the curve of the given member edges.
- **GetAnalyticalSupports** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the settings, the supported member part and the geometry of the given analytical supports.
- **GetAnalyticalLinks** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the settings, the connected member parts and the geometry of the given analytical links.
- **CreateAnalyticalSupports** (since 1.8.0): Creates analytical supports from their settings and supported member part, as GetAnalyticalSupports returns them, in one undo step.
- **CreateAnalyticalLinks** (since 1.8.0): Creates analytical links from their settings and connected member parts, as GetAnalyticalLinks returns them, in one undo step.
- **ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortest** (since 1.8.0): Converts the given shortest analytical links (associative to a curve member or a surface member edge) to links connected to a fixed coordinate, in one undo step, and returns the converted links.
- **GetAnalyticalLoads** (since 1.8.0): Retrieves the settings, the loaded member part, the custom data (the curve of an edge load, the contour of a surface load) and the geometry of the given analytical point, edge and surface loads.
- **CreateAnalyticalLoads** (since 1.8.0): Creates analytical point, edge and surface loads from their settings, loaded member part and custom data, as GetAnalyticalLoads returns them, in one undo step.
- **CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembers** (since 2.0.0): Creates elements (beams, columns, walls, slabs, roofs) from the given curve, surface or segmented surface members, in the form GetAnalyticalMemberDetails returns them, optionally with the settings of a favorite, in one undo step.

## Solid Element Operation Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/solid-element-operation.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/solid-element-operation.md).

- **CreateSolidElementLinks** (since 1.5.4): Creates solid element operation links between target and operator elements.
- **RemoveSolidElementLinks** (since 1.5.4): Removes solid element operation links between target and operator elements.
- **GetSolidElementLinks** (since 1.5.4): Returns solid element operation links for each queried element, grouped by role (target or operator).
- **CreateSolidOperations** (since 1.8.0): Runs a solid operation (subtraction, intersection, addition) on two morphs and returns the resulting morphs, one item per operation.
- **TrimElements** (since 1.5.9): Trims construction elements with a roof or shell: the roofs and shells in the list, or one given trimming element with a trim type.
- **RemoveElementTrims** (since 1.5.9): Removes the trim between an element and the roof or shell trimming it.
- **RemoveElementTrimDirection** (since 2.0.1): Removes one direction of a trim: the trim of an element by a roof or shell, keeping the other direction when the two trim each other (two roofs or shells).
- **GetElementTrims** (since 1.5.9): Which roofs and shells trim each queried element, with the trim type, and which elements it trims.
- **MergeElements** (since 1.8.0): Merges the given construction elements (the Merge command of Archicad, which cleans up the junctions of slabs, beams, walls and similar elements).
- **UnmergeElements** (since 1.8.0): Removes the merge between the two elements of each given pair.
- **GetMergedElements** (since 1.8.0): Gets the elements each queried element is merged with, one item per queried element; an unknown element is an error item.

## Script UI Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/script-ui.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/script-ui.md).

- **ShowScriptUI** (since 1.5.4): Shows the given HTML content in a native Archicad palette (a tkinter alternative for Python scripts) and returns the uiId of its window.
- **GetScriptUIResult** (since 1.5.4): Retrieves and clears the result last submitted from a Script UI window's page (via window.ACAPI.SubmitResult), if any, and reports whether the window is still open, so a waiting script can stop when the user closes it.
- **OpenSettingsDialog** (since 2.0.0): Opens Archicad's settings dialog of the selected elements or the current tool (Archicad 28 and later), or the default settings dialog of the given element type, waits for the user and reports whether the dialog was closed with OK or Cancel.
- **PickLibraryPart** (since 2.0.0): Opens Archicad's Object, Lamp, Window or Door Settings dialog, optionally limited to a library part subtype, lets the user pick a library part and set its parameters, and returns the chosen library part with its GDL parameters, or that the user cancelled.
- **PickLibraryPartFile** (since 2.0.0): Opens Archicad's Open Library Part dialog, waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen library part, or reports that the user cancelled.
- **PickPictureFile** (since 2.0.0): Opens Archicad's Open Picture dialog (the one of the texture settings), waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen picture, or reports that the user cancelled.
- **PickZoneStampOrLabelFile** (since 2.0.0): Opens Archicad's dialog for opening a zone stamp or label library part, waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen file, or reports that the user cancelled.
- **PickLibraryPartSaveLocation** (since 2.0.0): Opens Archicad's Save Library Part dialog (object, door or window), waits for the user and returns the location chosen to save the library part to, or reports that the user cancelled.
- **PickLibraryFolder** (since 2.0.0): Opens Archicad's dialog for choosing or creating a library folder, waits for the user and returns the location of the folder, or reports that the user cancelled.
- **ShowIFCExportSettings** (since 2.0.0): Opens Archicad's IFC export settings dialog, where the user picks a view and an IFC export translator, waits for the user and returns the chosen view and translator, or cancelled.
- **PickAttribute** (since 2.0.0): Opens a small dialog with Archicad's attribute picker for the given attribute type (layer, building material, composite, profile or surface; fill and line from Archicad 27), waits for the user and returns the chosen attribute, or cancelled.
- **PickAttributeFolder** (since 2.0.0): Opens a small dialog with Archicad's attribute folder picker for the given attribute type, waits for the user and returns the chosen folder as its path from the root folder, or cancelled.

## Developer Commands

Parameters, results and examples: [commands/developer.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands/developer.md).

- **GenerateDocumentation** (since 1.0.7): Generates files for the documentation.
